behavior: The hero is full width and full height with no rounded frame, its text is readable, and the waitlist field has clean padding, autofill colors and a readable success state
acceptance: Given / at 1440x900 and 390x844, then the hero touches both viewport edges with no outer margin or rounded corners, and on desktop it fills the viewport height
Given the hero, then the subhead and the beta note have >= 4.5:1 contrast against the pixels behind them (browser test sampling the background)
Given a browser-autofilled email, then the field shows the surface color, not the browser's autofill tint; the input fills the pill height with even padding

Given name@example.com submitted, then the pill itself shows 'You're on the list' with a check icon on a solid surface (no greyed-out button, no text directly on the landscape); an invalid email shows its error on a solid surface
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: All 4 acceptance lines met. Ran: playwright landing+waitlist+a11y+kit = 33 passed; ui-web vitest = 13 passed. (1) Full bleed: hero.tsx drops m-2/rounded, lg:min-h-svh; test checks left=0, right=clientWidth, radius 0 on section and art, height>=900 at 1440. Screenshots desktop-first-viewport.png and mobile.png show edge-to-edge art, no frame. (2) Contrast: contrast.ts is sound. It reads the resting text color, makes the text transparent, screenshots the text box (animations disabled, so the color change applies), and takes the 5th-percentile ratio over sampled pixels. Not trivially passing: I measured 1440 subhead/note 7.09/7.94 with the scrim and 6.13/5.66 without; 390 6.18/9.89 and 5.61/9.16; pale #bcd note text gives 1.01. (3) Autofill: email-capture.tsx:75 uses autofill: inset 10rem shadow with --fw-surface plus -webkit-text-fill-color ink, the standard Chrome override. h-10 input in a 54px pill (12px padding + 2px border), diff <=14 checked. Rule-presence test plus code is enough proof because real autofill cannot be triggered in a test. (4) Success: the form is replaced by a role=status pill with check icon, message and email on bg-surface; no button left; error sits on a bg-surface chip; waitlist-states.png and the kit group show all four states. Minor follow-ups, not blocking: (a) email-capture.tsx:39 comment says content below does not move, but the success pill with the email line is 58px vs the 54px form pill, so the beta note moves 4px (measured at 1440x900, 390x844, 1440x700; at 1440x700 the hero grows 4px). (b) email-capture.tsx:30 mounts role=status together with its text while the old aria-live region (line 86) unmounts; some screen readers do not announce a live region that arrives already filled. A persistent live wrapper would be safer. Focus drops to body after success, same as before (the old button was disabled). Label and aria-describedby still work for errors. (c) types/ui/email-capture.ts:7 doc still says the success text is shown under the field. Note: an orphaned next start -p 3101 from the screenshot run (parent launchd) blocked Playwright; I stopped it before rerunning.
